sources.historical: SXF_arastirma_arsivi daily outcome JSON 9–27 Oct (research reconstructions and 27 Oct dynamic; original time-window scope retained), league lookup by fixture_uid from scan files/archives/fixtures
sources.later: Supabase public.sxf_base_signal_events eligible FINAL_SIGNAL / eligible EARLY_SIGNAL 28 Oct–27 Nov, public.fixtures and live_fixtures FT, exact fixture_uid joins to GitHub archive daily checkpoints 28 Oct–26 Nov

grading: Within engine unique fixture_uid+engine+side; 90-minute score, 1X2 direct win, OVER>=3, BTTS both score, SURPRISE nonloss; no nonloss ROI; flat 1 unit gross ROI on recorded decimal odds for other engines; no costs. EARLY_CORE_ORIGIN and EARLY_CORE_V2_ORIGIN are raw eligible origin triggers not retention/decision-price-verified final picks. EARLY_T12 is retired. Preliminary and price-filter rejects excluded; experimental final engines included separately. No new threshold or league exclusion approved.
limitations: Historical and newer provenance differ, not a uniform replay or complete census of every theoretical signal.

266 engine-selection rows with unverified/missing score or nonfinal game are excluded from hit rate; 21 engine-selection rows without league excluded from league ranks. Exact labels retained; no external score verification. 0 archived/live FT score conflicts among matched sources. Early decision retention not reconstructed. No out-of-sample validation or statistical significance claim.
Min 5 settled for exploratory league ranking, min 10 separate larger sample; overlapping engine tags not independent observations.
